title: cross-source-review doc-findings
description: The schema'd output of a review leg (the same-family doc-reviewer agent OR the different-family substrate) on a doc-shaped artifact. One finding per real defect, each citing concrete evidence. Generalized from blueprint-crafting's review-findings.schema.json: the field shape is preserved (defect_id / severity / kind / location / evidence / suggestion) but the `kind` enum is the doc-domain set (Q2). severity keeps blueprint-crafting's {blocker, warning, coverage} — `coverage` is the reviewer's honest-disclosure 'could not verify X' (workspace rule 3), DISTINCT from the `coverage-gap` KIND which is a defect in the artifact (a missing section). The reviewer NEVER edits files — this JSON is its sole output. Validated in infra/test/findings_shape_check.py.

outcome_axis_respected.description: The leg asserts it did NOT judge outcome-axis questions (whether the doc is 'right' / the requirement is correct / the conclusion is true). True on every conformant review — both same-family and different-family legs are barred from outcome-axis.

findings.description: One entry per real defect (or coverage disclosure). Empty when the artifact is clean.

defect_id.description: Stable id for this finding (e.g. 'novel-1'). The different-family leg is fed prior findings by id so it hunts the gap, not restatements.

severity.description: blocker = real defect blocking convergence (needs concrete evidence — a quote); warning = suspected/advisory (never blocks — rule 4); coverage = 'could not verify X' honest disclosure (rule 3).

kind.description: The doc-domain defect category (Q2). contradiction = two claims conflict, or a claim conflicts with a cited source; authority-chain-break = a claim cites a source that does not say what the doc says; scope-creep = over-reaches stated non-goals / conflates domains; structural-gap = a load-bearing concept is undefined or a step is missing; citation-error = a file/section/field citation is wrong or unverifiable; coverage-gap = something that should be addressed for soundness is absent. NOTE: the coverage-gap KIND (a defect in the artifact) is DISTINCT from the coverage SEVERITY (the reviewer's own honest disclosure).

location.description: Where: doc section heading, line range, or anchor id. Concrete enough to act on.

evidence.description: Concrete quote from the artifact (and from the source verified against, when applicable) + why it is a defect. A Blocker with no quote is downgraded.

suggestion.description: Optional one-line fix direction. The leg does NOT apply it (report-only).
